summary: Dortmund did not read the script, remaining level on points with the defending champions at the top of the tableIt was the moment they had all been … not so much waiting for, but planning, pushing and yearning for.

On the green screen grabs that announce the starting lineup on the giant scoreboard before kick-off, every Bayern Munich player turns to face the camera with their personal salute, greeting or goal celebration, the playful progression from the standard folding of arms.
This, however, was the real party, the moment where the England captain’s and Bayern’s successful union and the apex it has reached was celebrated in front of a global audience.

summary: Before this weekend, the last time Folarin Balogun scored was in the United States’ 2-0 win over Bosnia and Herzegovina at this past summer’s World Cup.

summary: Athletic’s win over Real Sociedad was culmination of six unique days for the Spain keeper after night at PalladiumFor the third time in six days everyone got to their feet to hand a standing ovation to Unai Simón, dressed in all black, before the world.
Named the best men’s goalkeeper on the planet, holding the Lev Yashin trophy, they had applauded him at the London Palladium on Monday night and before the game began at San Mamés, Bilbao, on Sunday.

stories.title: Zero passing yards, one win. Did the Bucs just reinvent the NFL in all the wrong ways?
summary: So, Sunday’s performance by Baker Mayfield and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers had me positively gobsmacked.

By completing a grand total of zero passes out of a paltry three attempts, Baker Mayfield led the Bucs to the first game with no passing offense since the Buffalo Bills beat the New York Jets 16-12 on 29 September 1974.
Combined with Mayfield, they rushed 56 times for 324 yards – the most ever in a single game for the Bucs.
